acc.optional: Accounts are optional. You never need one to learn; an account only adds sync between devices, a public profile and leaderboards.
acc.register-intro: Only a username and a password. No email. Your password is turned into a key on this device and never sent to the server.
acc.username-hint: 3–24 letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore. It appears on leaderboards if you opt in, so choose one that is not your real name if you prefer.
acc.password-hint: At least 8 characters. There is no email, so there is no password reset other than the recovery code you will get next.
acc.recover-intro: Enter your username, the recovery code you saved at registration and a new password.
acc.welcome.title: Welcome
acc.recovery-intro: This code is the only way to get back in if you forget your password, because there is no email. It is shown once. Keep it somewhere safe and private.
acc.recovery-saved: I have saved my recovery code
acc.copy-failed: Copying failed. Please select the code and copy it yourself.
acc.signed-out: Signed out. Your progress stays on this device.
acc.sync-note: While you are signed in, your save file and summary numbers are synced every few minutes. Merging keeps the newer and larger entries, so nothing is lost.
acc.optin-help: Leaderboards are off for you until you switch them on. When on, your username, level and summary numbers (XP, accuracy, study time, streak) are public. Nothing else is, unless you make a profile field public below.
acc.optin: Show me on public leaderboards and give me a public profile page
acc.profile-help: Every field is private by default. Choose “Public” only for what you want others to see.
acc.minor-note: Under 18: names, job, education, city and the about text are never shown publicly.
acc.groups-help: Create a group and share its invitation code, or join one with a code. Group members see each other's username and summary numbers.
acc.no-groups: You are not in a group yet.
acc.data-help: You can download everything the server holds about you, or delete your account and all of it at any time. Your progress on this device is not deleted.
acc.delete-msg: Your username, profile, summary numbers, cloud save and group memberships will be deleted from the server. This cannot be undone.

home.title: Learn the theories, level by level
home.lead: Short cards, questions that make you think, exams, spaced review and progress that is saved on your own device. Free, accessible and works offline.
home.f1.d: Every lesson is a sequence of one-minute cards, each followed by a small question.
home.f2.t: Go as deep as you like.
home.f2.d: Core cards are the path; optional deep-dive cards add the finest detail.
home.f3.d: Spaced review boxes and a mistakes notebook bring back what you forget.
home.f4.d: Unit exams, mixed mock exams, timed or untimed, with an analysis by topic.
home.f5.d: Saved automatically in your browser; export a save file any time. No account needed.
home.f6.d: No sound, keyboard and screen-reader friendly, seven display themes including e-ink paper mode.
